returned.name: gatewayRefused

returned.name: gatewayTimeout
returned.summary: Gateway attempt timed out: the deadline fired with no reply.

returned.name: gatewayHttp5xx
returned.summary: Gateway replied 5xx: the pod proxy routed but the gateway or host errored.

returned.name: gatewayDns
returned.summary: Gateway host name did not resolve.

returned.name: gatewayNetwork

returned.name: backendHttpStatus
returned.summary: Simeon Labs backend replied with a non-ok HTTP status.

returned.name: backendUnreachable
returned.summary: Simeon Labs backend was unreachable over the transport.

returned.name: backendDeliveryFailed
returned.summary: Backend delivery attempt failed outside the status and errno shapes; the caller retries with backoff.

returned.name: logShipTimeout
returned.summary: A structured-log submitLogs attempt hit the transport submit deadline; the batch requeues and redelivers.

returned.name: streamStalled
returned.summary: Established gateway event stream went silent past the stall watchdog and was torn down; the loop reconnects.

returned.name: localExecNoProviders
returned.summary: Local-machine action refused: no desktop is registered on the reverse local-exec channel.

returned.name: localExecProvidersStale
returned.summary: Local-machine action refused: desktops are registered on the reverse local-exec channel but none heartbeated inside the liveness window.

returned.name: localExecComputerUnknown
returned.summary: Local-machine action refused: the addressed computer matches no registered desktop connection.

returned.name: boxAccessDenied
returned.summary: Backend refused box access for a NO_STORAGE (privacy-mode) account.

returned.name: gatewayAccessDenied
returned.summary: Gateway attempt was refused by an auth/entitlement gate (401/403); a retry cannot fix it.

returned.name: connectorAuthStartRefused
returned.summary: Connector OAuth flow could not start: the connector cannot mint a sign-in link in its current state.

returned.name: connectorAuthStartFailed
returned.summary: Connector OAuth flow failed to start: the backend OAuth status probe failed.

returned.name: connectorOauthCallbackFailed
returned.summary: Connector OAuth callback did not complete: the provider redirected an error or no code, or the backend rejected the exchange.
returned.seededFrom: loopback handleRequest failure branches in mcp-oauth-loopback.ts

returned.name: connectorAuthAbandoned
returned.summary: Connector OAuth flow expired: the started flow's token never landed within the watch window.

returned.name: webauthnNoProvider
returned.summary: WebAuthn proxy ceremony refused: no desktop is registered on the reverse WebAuthn channel.

returned.name: webauthnProviderStale
returned.summary: WebAuthn proxy ceremony refused: desktops are registered but none heartbeated inside the liveness window.

returned.name: webauthnCeremonyTimedOut
returned.summary: WebAuthn proxy ceremony timed out: the desktop never settled it inside the ceremony deadline.

returned.name: webauthnConsentDeclined
returned.summary: WebAuthn proxy ceremony declined by the user at the desktop consent prompt.

returned.name: webauthnSignFailed
returned.summary: WebAuthn proxy signing leg failed on the desktop: the signer reported a DOMException instead of an assertion.

returned.name: webauthnDesktopFailed
returned.summary: WebAuthn proxy ceremony failed on the desktop outside the declined and signing shapes, or an older desktop reported no stage attribution.

returned.name: webauthnDispatchFailed
returned.summary: WebAuthn proxy ceremony dispatch failed: the selected desktop's request stream refused the ceremony write.

returned.name: sessionRefreshHttpStatus
returned.summary: Simeon session token refresh got a non-ok HTTP status; the session is kept and a later refresh may succeed.

returned.name: sessionRefreshNetwork
returned.summary: Simeon session token refresh failed on the transport before any backend verdict; the session is kept.

returned.name: sessionRefreshBadPayload
returned.summary: Simeon session token refresh returned an ok status without a usable token payload; the session is kept.
returned.seededFrom: unreadable body / empty access_token branches in account-auth.ts runRefreshAccessToken

returned.name: sessionRefreshRejected
returned.summary: Simeon session refresh was terminally rejected (backend shouldLogout verdict or an unparseable token response) with no rotation-race rescue; the user was signed out.
returned.seededFrom: shouldLogout / parse-failure sign-out in account-auth.ts runRefreshAccessToken

returned.name: sessionPolicyRefused
returned.summary: Simeon session refresh was refused by the device's MDM sign-in policy; the user was signed out.
returned.seededFrom: MDM policy verdict in account-auth.ts runRefreshAccessToken

returned.name: sessionSecretsUnavailable
returned.summary: OS secure storage is unavailable, so the signed-in session's sign-in tokens are held in memory only and will not survive a restart.

returned.name: bootStageStalled
returned.summary: Box rebuild stalled before completing a boot stage.

returned.name: hostLifecycleStalled
returned.summary: In-box host startup stalled inside a lifecycle phase.

returned.name: hostLifecycleFailed
returned.summary: In-box host startup failed inside a lifecycle phase.

returned.name: boxImageCheckTimedOut
returned.summary: Box image-update check hit its deadline before the backend answered.

returned.name: boxImageCheckFailed
returned.summary: Box image-update check failed before its deadline.

returned.name: providerOverloaded
returned.summary: Model provider is overloaded (capacity or rate limit).

returned.name: firstTokenStall
returned.summary: Model provider streamed nothing within the first-token deadline.

returned.name: streamReset
returned.summary: Turn stream dropped on a transient transport reset.

returned.name: contextWindowOverflow
returned.summary: Turn hit a context-window overflow dead end a retry would repeat.

returned.name: backendRejected
returned.summary: Backend rejected the turn with a terminal structured error.

returned.name: turnRetryable
returned.summary: Turn failed retryably outside every more specific shape.

returned.name: agentUnclassified
returned.summary: Agent-path operation failed outside every classified shape.

returned.name: backendCapacityDeferred
returned.summary: Backend deferred the turn at capacity with a server-paced retry-after; the runner sleeps the paced delay and retries.

returned.name: memorySynthesisInvalidOutput
returned.summary: Memory synthesis produced an invalid proposal: unparseable output, an unknown evidence citation, or a change the memory state rejected.
returned.seededFrom: MemorySynthesisAttemptError invalid-output + applySynthesis invalid in memory-synthesis-service.ts

returned.name: memorySynthesisRejected
returned.summary: Memory synthesis verification did not approve the proposed changes.

returned.name: memorySynthesisStale
returned.summary: Memory files changed under a synthesis run; the pending evidence re-queues against the fresh state.

returned.name: memorySynthesisEvidenceDropped
returned.summary: Pending synthesis evidence was shed by a capacity cap before any run consumed it.

returned.name: memorySynthesisFailed
returned.summary: Memory synthesis run failed outside the classified shapes (inference transport or deadline).

returned.name: conversationTooLarge
returned.summary: Turn refused at the conversation-size hard cap: the live conversation tree is over the limit and GC could not shrink it, so the refusal repeats until GC succeeds or the user starts a new conversation.

returned.name: updateFeedFetchFailed
returned.summary: Update-feed fetch threw before any HTTP status arrived (network, DNS, or TLS transport).

returned.name: updateFeedHttpStatus
returned.summary: Update server replied with a non-ok HTTP status.

returned.name: updateFeedMalformed
returned.summary: Update server's response body failed the feed schema.

returned.name: updateCheckAborted
returned.summary: Update check aborted before a result (dispose, track change, or gate change); the next scheduled check retries.

returned.name: updateDisabledByEnv
returned.summary: Updater is inert: updates disabled by environment override.

returned.name: updateDisabledLabBuild
returned.summary: Updater is inert: a Sand Lab one-off build outside every track never self-updates.

returned.name: updateDisabledNotPackaged
returned.summary: Updater is inert: an unpackaged development run has nothing to update.

returned.name: updateDisabledUnsupportedPlatform
returned.summary: Updater is inert: the platform has no supported update path.

returned.name: updateStagedNotAdopted
returned.summary: A Squirrel-staged desktop build was not the one running on the next launch: ShipIt did not swap it in (an apply failure, or an unclean termination that skipped the swap). The updater re-stages on its next check.

returned.name: updateApplyIncomplete
returned.summary: An explicit restart-to-update was requested but the next launch still ran the old build: the handoff (ShipIt swap, or the parked Windows installer) never completed.

returned.name: updateInstallerSpawnFailed
returned.summary: The parked Windows installer failed to spawn as the app quit for restart-to-update; the user relaunches into the old build.
returned.seededFrom: installOnQuit spawn-error callback recorded by applyStagedOnQuit

returned.name: updateAutoRelaunchFailed
returned.summary: The update applied but the post-install auto-relaunch never brought Sand back; the confirm arrived late, from a manual launch (SAND-1269).

returned.name: desktopStartupFailed
returned.summary: Desktop bootstrap threw before the app finished starting; the payload names the phase that was in progress.

returned.name: desktopStartupStuck
returned.summary: Desktop bootstrap sat in one phase past the stuck watchdog without finishing, failing, or quitting.

returned.name: desktopUncaughtException
returned.summary: Desktop main process uncaught exception, kept alive by the process crash guard.

returned.name: desktopUnhandledRejection
returned.summary: Desktop main process unhandled promise rejection, kept alive by the process crash guard.

returned.name: desktopChildProcessGone
returned.summary: An Electron child process (renderer, GPU, or utility) died abnormally under the desktop main process.

returned.name: desktopCoordinatorHandoffFailed
returned.summary: A coordinator port handoff leg threw while transferring a data port; the next request or relaunch re-serves.

returned.name: desktopCoordinatorExitTimeout
returned.summary: A departing coordinator did not confirm exit within the account-handoff deadline; the handoff blocked on a zombie.

returned.name: desktopLocalExecSpawnFailed
returned.summary: The detached local-exec daemon failed to spawn from the desktop bundle.

returned.name: desktopVncLivenessStall
returned.summary: The interactive box-desktop viewer forwarded repeated key/click input while the framebuffer drew nothing and the wire stayed silent for the rolling window: the connected-but-frozen fingerprint the RFB lifecycle cannot see.

returned.name: desktopUncleanExit
returned.summary: A prior desktop session's alive marker was never settled by a clean quit: the main process died out from under the app (native crash, OS OOM kill, force-quit, or power loss), observed and reported at the next boot.

returned.name: clientSliceCorrupt
returned.summary: A persisted Client slice failed its envelope parse or its owner's value codec at load; the owner resets the slice.

returned.name: clientSliceIoError
returned.summary: A Client persistence port operation (read, write, remove, or list) threw.

returned.name: clientSliceQuotaExceeded
returned.summary: A Client slice write was refused for storage quota; retrying cannot free space.
returned.seededFrom: isQuotaFailure branch of reportThrown in client/persistence.ts

returned.name: clientQueuedFlushNonceMismatch
returned.summary: A queued send reached the Host with a nonce whose accepted digest did not match.

returned.name: clientQueuedFlushCapabilityUnavailable
returned.summary: A queued send could not flush because the Host lacks the required send capability.

returned.name: clientQueuedFlushHostRejected
returned.summary: Acceptance-status resolution proved that the Host rejected a queued send.
returned.seededFrom: rejected acceptance status in client/send/send-journal.ts resolveRecord

returned.name: clientQueuedSendSuperseded
returned.summary: An explicit recovery action retired an offline-queued send without delivery proof.

returned.name: clientQueuedSendAckExpired
returned.summary: A flushed queued send received no authoritative echo before its online ACK deadline.

returned.name: journalAppendFailed
returned.summary: Committing the prepared transcript WAL into the canonical journal failed; the checkpoint stays durable and the turn path surfaces the error.

returned.name: journalCheckpointFailed
returned.summary: Deriving or writing the pending transcript WAL checkpoint failed before anything was committed.

returned.name: journalCorruptTail
returned.summary: The transcript journal was missing, truncated, or torn at open for a conversation with durable history; it was discarded and rebuilt from the checkpoint.

returned.name: journalReplayFailed
returned.summary: Reconciling the pending transcript WAL against the durable checkpoint at recover failed; the journal cannot advance until the mismatch resolves.

returned.name: journalRebuildFailed
returned.summary: Re-deriving the transcript journal from the durable checkpoint failed after a corrupt or absent journal was discarded; the next recover retries the rebuild.
